_comment: Settlement patrons (TownshipManager.set_worship). One patron at a time, chosen once a Shrine stands; switching is free. Each modifier is granted per Shrine level, so the Shrine is what deepens the blessing.

patron_gale.name: The Gale
patron_gale.description: Keeper of the Observatory of Gales. Hands move quicker to learn what the wind already knows.

patron_tide.name: The Tide
patron_tide.description: Warden of the Tidal Reliquary. What goes out comes back, and a little more besides.

patron_stone.name: The Deepstone
patron_stone.description: Sleeper beneath the Deepstone Sanctum. Blows land on you as they would on a mountain.

patron_ember.name: The Ember
patron_ember.description: Tender of the Emberthrone Kiln. Every strike carries a little of the forge's heat.
